title: Is there anyone here who used to regularly lucid dream and then those dreams turned into the mallworld dream and now you can't lucid dream the same?

classification.question_topic: Asking if others experienced frequent lucid dreaming (flying on command) that decreased over time and was replaced by recurring 'mallworld' dreams, with reduced ability to lucid dream.
